content: what is the embedding  document about?

The document is about text embeddings, which are vector representations of text that power applications like retrieval, question answering, semantic textual similarity, and clustering. It also mentions recent advances in LLMs showing that a single model can generate embeddings excelling across diverse tasks. (embeddings.pdf, Page: 1)

content: does it relate with attention document?

Yes, both documents relate to attention.

The `embeddings.pdf` document mentions that LLMs typically employ unidirectional attention during pre-training, where tokens only attend to preceding tokens (embeddings.pdf, Page 2, 3).

The `attention.pdf` document describes Self-attention (sometimes called intra-attention) as an attention mechanism relating different positions. It also mentions Multi-Head Attention, which counteracts reduced effective resolution due to averaging attention-weighted positions (attention.pdf, Page 2).
